# Onboarding

Every configurable value in this plugin has its home here, and no skill
hard-codes one. Nine other skills read what this produces.

**Who is answering.** A quality manager, a supervisor, an estimator or a plant
manager — not an IT admin. Ask in their language, one question at a time, and
treat "I'd have to ask" as a complete answer.

**Hand-hold, don't interrogate.** Say what each step is for before asking
anything in it, read what the plant can hand over before asking what it
can't, and turn every question a document already answered into *confirm or
correct*, naming the file.

**Setup never blocks.** Every group can be deferred. A deferred group goes on the
gaps list with the skills it limits named, and the run completes.

**Quick start**

```
→ 1  Ask which ERP, CAD, CMMS and documents system; test the four supported connectors
→ 2  Bulk document drop: name the exact documents, skip what a live connector covers
→ 3  Export folder and dropped files; confirm every file one at a time
→ 4  Time interview, then cross-check a shared event for clock skew
```

**Every other system is named, not one of the four.** The plant names whatever it
runs — SAP, SolidWorks, Limble, a homegrown MES — and any name is accepted.

# The interview — every config group, in order

**Who is answering.** A quality manager, a supervisor, an estimator or a plant
manager. Not an IT admin. Ask in their language, one question at a time, and
accept "I'd have to ask" as a complete answer.

**The whole interview is answerable in one sitting**, and every group can be

Run in this order. It front-loads what can be read rather than asked, so the
user answers fewer questions.

| # | Group | Mostly read, or mostly asked |
|---|---|---|

| 2 | Documents | Collected in bulk, classified, mined |

| 4 | Time configuration | Asked, then tested |
| 5 | Vocabulary and report depth | Asked, short — or confirm-or-correct from documents |
| 6 | Sites | Asked, short |
| 7 | Capability profile and machining data | Asked, medium — mostly confirm-or-correct where a routing or asset register came in |
| 8 | Standards, clauses and approved suppliers | Collected as documents |
| 9 | Templates | Collected as files |
| 10 | Commercial rates | Asked, shown once for a yes, saved as confirmed in the plant profile unless set in the environment |

correct*, naming the file.** *"Your quality manual says AS9100 Rev D, certificate
expiring March 2027 — still right?"* Never ask the user to retype what they
just handed over.

whether there is more than one plant before capturing anything that varies by
plant.

One open question per category. **Name no product as an option**: a list of
examples reads as the plugin's preference, and the person types what they
actually run. Any name, or none, is accepted.

# The systems landscape, and where common systems land today

Give the engineer a head start, but **re-verify at build time** — this
landscape moves quickly, and a system that was Tier 3 last quarter may be
Tier 1 now.

---

## What plants actually run, by category

| Category | What plants actually run | Access reality |
|---|---|---|
| ERP | SAP S/4HANA and ECC, Infor M3, Infor CloudSuite/LN, Epicor Kinetic, Plex, Global Shop, JobBoss, E2 | Most have REST or OData APIs. SAP exposes OData services and the BTP layer. API access is sometimes a separately-priced license tier |
| MES | Tulip, Plex MES, Aegis, Critical Manufacturing — plus a great deal of homegrown | Cloud ones have APIs; homegrown usually means a database or an export |
| Historian / SCADA | AVEVA/OSIsoft PI, Ignition, Wonderware, Kepware | PI has a Web API; Ignition has a web API and SQL access. Usually on-prem and firewalled |
| Quality / QMS | ETQ, MasterControl, Greenlight Guru, IQS | Mostly REST |
| PLM | Windchill, Teamcenter, Arena, Autodesk Vault | Varies widely; Vault is on-prem |

**A large share of what's running in mid-market plants is on-prem, a
decade old, and has a SQL database but no API at all.** That's not a
failure case — it's the normal case, and the access ladder has an answer
for it at Tier 4 or Tier 7.

| Microsoft 365 | 1 — supported | Anthropic connector. Read-only by default, write is admin opt-in, no Teams write path |
